summary: Skill code-review run by the implementer before updating the PR, at xhigh effort over the committed diff (10 finder angles, dedup, gap sweep). 8 findings. Fixed 5: the refused-carry reason was written to warnings only, which shiki_loop._resolve_blocking_reasons never reads, so it now goes to blocking_reasons when the gate blocks; the proven-carry disclosure claimed 'approval carried' on PRs blocked for a missing label and now states a fact about the carry alone; added test_a_proven_carry_on_a_blocked_pr_never_claims_approval and test_a_guardian_negation_is_not_disclosed_twice for the two previously untested behaviours; factored the thrice-duplicated refusal filter into _mg_carry_refusals beside _mg_carried; renamed test_base_drift_is_the_only_divergence_axis to test_gate_and_signal_name_the_same_refusal_on_the_advanced_base, which is what it asserts. Deferred 1 out of scope with the reason recorded in the PR body: shiki_guardian_status.py renders result.blockers and still drops the same carry fields. Remaining 2 were the constitution finding this registration answers.
